name: RADT DAO wrap withdraw arbitrary transfer
summary: The RADT wrapper's withdraw(address,address,uint256) let any caller move RADT out of an arbitrary account, so the attacker stripped the RADT/USDT pair, synced it and sold RADT into the drained reserves.

loss.notes: Imported rounded estimate. Source-4 reproduces 94304.580256723571814836 USDT depletion for the recorded transaction; full campaign valuation remains unresolved.

ageReset.description: Implementation activation reproduced by prestateTracer diffMode; latest causal configuration remains unresolved.

limitations: Later wrapper configuration writes and token authority history have not been fully adjudicated; implementation activation is provisional age basis.

sources.note: Partial review, not promotion. Reproduce source-1 eth_getTransactionReceipt: USDT 0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955 (18 decimals), Transfer log 22 pays 95305580256723571814836 raw units from pair 0xaf8fb60f310dcd8e488e4fa10c48907b7abf115e to attacker helper; logs 2 and 9 supply 1000000000000000000000 and 1000000000000000000 raw units to that pair. Recorded-transaction depletion after removing campaign inputs is 94304.580256723571814836 USDT; full campaign scope remains unresolved. source-1 debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) shows helper 0x90b50cab27ede09a0d59743e4112d6e87e838ff4 directly calling wrapper selector 0xd9caed12, delegatecalling the recorded implementation; wrapper invokes token 0xdc8cb92aa6fc7277e3ec32e3f00ad7b8437ae883. Reproduce eth_getLogs for that token Transfer topic with pair as topic1 over blocks 20579790..21572419: 4522 logs in 4309 unique transactions. Trace each with callTracer and filter wrapper calls with selector 0xd9caed12 whose caller is not that token: only source-1 matches, with zero trace errors. This bounds earlier pair depletion only, not arbitrary token-holder abuse or later campaigns. source-6 receipt identifies deployment block/index; source-5 prestateTracer(diffMode=true) witnesses the implementation slot before/after values stored in ageReset. The slot is keccak256(eip1967.proxy.implementation), one greater than the standard EIP-1967 slot. Unresolved: latest causal configuration, full first-use and campaign scope. Next: classify wrapper persistent reads against all configuration writes after activation, inspect token authority history, and extend Transfer/call-trace scan beyond pair-origin transfers and beyond recorded incident to the fix. Later wrapper txlist identifies withdrawal 0x35f01ebce53727872ef601d30fcbb73e9f53f62ea8e5a06988a122b643f129ff at block 21625307 and implementation change 0xa3c7e285d0628bdf547ce1568cb50907fcc74b959134ac02d61997776af52d8e at 21625505. Next campaign-scope step: trace that withdrawal and test whether it repeats the fault before treating the later implementation change as a fix.

limitations: Earliest arbitrary-holder abuse and later campaigns remain unresolved; source-4 gives the exact bounded scan and next steps.
Full campaign valuation and latest causal configuration remain provisional.
